summary: L-5 ground cabin on a rocky point near Dexter, Oregon, built 1933, staffed in the 1930s and removed in 1971; now a hiking viewpoint.

facts.design: 10x10-foot Aladdin L-5 ground cabin (Rex's page); L-5 ground cabin (FFLOS)
facts.status_note: The lookout house was removed in 1971. The rocky point is now a trail viewpoint.

staffing.status: Forest Service lookout attendants named in 1933 and 1936 newspaper items

access.note: Oregon Hikers describes a trail hike to the old lookout site. The sources mention no closure or gate.

visit.trail_note: Lower trailhead 2.3 miles from the summit with 1,400 ft of gain; upper trailhead 0.5 miles from the summit. Open year round except after winter snows.
visit.drive_up: From I-5 exit 188, drive 20.8 miles east on Highway 58, turn right on Goodman Creek Road and continue 3.2 miles to the trailhead.

notes_for_editor: Build year: 1933 (FFLOS, Rex's page) vs 1932 (firelookout.com, which may be following the August 1932 plan). Removal in 1971 is consistent across all five sources. The 1953 survey station description is quoted through Rex's page; we did not fetch the NGS datasheet itself, so the station's current condition is unknown. Oregon Hikers is a community-edited wiki; the trail details are current as of its cached copy and should be checked before publishing. Access 'public' comes from the trail guide; no closure appears in these sources, but no land manager statement was checked. Fact-check 2026-10-09: the FFLOS registration credit was corrected (the register names a private nominator, not the Forest Service, so the nominator is omitted here).
